description: Create, replace or (panel: null) remove a back office panel: a screen for the developer and their team. panel: { title, source: { table } | { booking: set } | { credits: kind }, columns: ["field" | { field, label }] (player.name, start, title… too), where: { field: value | { gte: "$today", lt: "$tomorrow" } } (dates: $now, $today, $tomorrow, $weekStart, $monthStart, $nextMonthStart), filters: [{ field, op?, label?, type? }] the person fills in, orderBy, limit (≤ 500), actions: [{ label, call: "booking.cancel" | "booking.move" | "credits.adjust" | "table.remove" | "table.save", args: { … "$row.field" | "$input.name" }, confirm? }] — on each row; or call "booking.createSlot", a button over the panel with a form (title, start, minutes, capacity, and how it repeats as in a calendar: freq, interval, byDay, byMonthDay, until or count), args filling it in beforehand }. e.g. "Reservas de hoy": { source: { booking: "clases" }, where: { start: { gte: "$today", lt: "$tomorrow" } }, columns: ["start", "title", "player.name"], actions: [{ label: "Cancelar", call: "booking.cancel", args: { refund: true }, confirm: "¿Cancelar?" }] }. A { booking } panel lists every slot of its range, free or not: a row per booking (with capacity and left, the places left) and one row with status "free" and no id for a slot nobody booked; row actions only on booking rows. Panels see every table and user: they are for the back office, never the app.

panel.description: The panel, or null to remove it
